profile_text.body:
IBM is a for-profit, publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. It reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker IBM, with SEC CIK 0000051143. The company's website, accessed through the OpenPages product page, describes IBM as offering a broad portfolio of enterprise technology products, with a notable concentration in AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance tooling.

IBM's primary AI governance products include IBM OpenPages with Watson and IBM watsonx.governance. The company describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in a single integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises. The platform includes an interactive workspace called the OpenPages GRC Canvas, embedded AI for automating classification and issue creation, an OpenPages MCP Server for enabling AI agents to interact with GRC objects, and an API-based architecture that allows integration with watsonx.ai or third-party AI models. IBM watsonx.governance is described as covering AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, and includes EU AI Act accelerators. IBM named watsonx.governance a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The broader IBM watsonx platform is described as a model-agnostic enterprise AI platform supporting agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also notes that IBM was recognized as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.
